sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [OWNERSHIP_PATH] gen:TRF111ShipShape / nltl:hasPropulsionLoadCase / nltl:fatigueSafetyFactor and gen:TRF111ShipShape / nltl:hasComponent: nltl:fatigueSafetyFactor is incorrectly constrained on nltl:loadCase even though its canonical owner is nltl:shipComponent; the correct ship-component path is present but nltl:hasComponent is not mandatory, so the required fatigue safety factor may be absent. Required change: Ensure the safety-factor result applicable to nltl:fatigueLoadCase is explicitly constrained with sh:minInclusive 1.5 and is linked through the required canonical ownership path.

[LOGIC] gen:TRF111ShipShape > nltl:hasPropulsionLoadCase > sh:or[2] > nltl:componentYieldSafetyFactor: The fatigue-load-case branch requires componentYieldSafetyFactor with a minimum of 1.5, although the requirement's 1.5 fatigue-load condition is represented by fatigueSafetyFactor. Required change: Remove the componentYieldSafetyFactor constraint from the fatigue-load-case branch and enforce nltl:fatigueSafetyFactor at least 1.5 for the applicable shafting components.
